Class BigBlockingQueue<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigBlockingQueue<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of element stored in the queue
public class BigBlockingQueue<T> extends Object
A thread-safe BigQueue where the pop() operation blocks until an element is available.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • peek

      public T peek() throws InterruptedException
      Blocks until at least one elements is in the queue and then returns, but does not remove, the element that has been on the queue the longest and which will be remove by the next call to pop.
      Returns:
      the element at the front of the queue
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted while waiting for an element to become available

    • push

      public void push(T element)
      Adds an element to the back of the queue. This element will not be popped until all elements on the queue at the time it was pushed have been popped.
      Parameters:
      element - the element to add to the queue

    • pop

      public T pop() throws InterruptedException
      Blocks until at least one element is in the queue and then removes and returns the element that has been on the queue the longest.
      Returns:
      the element that has been on the queue longest
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted while waiting for an element to become available
